<?php
class Owner187Life { public function &make() { $child = new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; return $child; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
$owner = new Owner187Life; $value =& $owner->make(); unset($owner); $alias =& $value; $copy = $alias; $value = null; echo 'HOLD;'; unset($copy); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
trait T187Scope { public static function &make() { $child = new class(self::VALUE, static::VALUE, __CLASS__, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $self, public int $called, public string $owner, public string $method) {} }; return $child; } }
class A187Scope { use T187Scope; public const VALUE = 1; } class C187Scope extends A187Scope { public const VALUE = 2; }
$value =& C187Scope::make(); echo $value->self, ';', $value->called, ';', $value->owner, ';', $value->method, ';', $value::class, ';';

<?php
$owner = new class { public function &make() { $child = new class {}; return $child; } };
$a =& $owner->make(); $b =& $owner->make(); $after = new class {}; echo $owner::class, ';', $a::class, ';', ($a::class === $b::class), ';', ($a !== $b), ';', $after::class, ';';

<?php
class Owner187Temp { public function &make() { return new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } }
$owner = new Owner187Temp; $value =& $owner->make(); echo 'HOLD;'; unset($value); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
function warn187($severity, $message) { echo 'WARN;'; throw new Exception('stop'); }
class Owner187Throw { public function &make() { return new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
set_error_handler('warn187'); try { $value =& (new Owner187Throw)->make(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo 'CAUGHT;'; }

<?php
class Owner187Closure { public const VALUE = 7; public function &capture() { $factory = function() { return new class(self::VALUE, __METHOD__) { public function __construct(public int $value, public string $method) {} }; }; return $factory; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
$owner = new Owner187Closure; $factory =& $owner->capture(); unset($owner); $child = $factory(); echo $child->value, ';', $child->method, ';', $child::class, ';'; unset($factory); echo 'DONE;';

<?php
function warn187($severity, $message) { echo 'WARN;'; throw new Exception('stop'); }
class Owner187Throw { public function &make() { return new class { public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
set_error_handler('warn187'); try { (new Owner187Throw)->make(); } catch (Exception $e) { echo 'CAUGHT;'; }
